title.zh: 微软布拉德·史密斯呼吁强制性AI规则与“断电开关”
title.en: Microsoft's Brad Smith calls for mandatory AI rules and kill switches

summary.zh: 微软总裁布拉德·史密斯呼吁出台强制性AI监管，设立“断电开关”并对失控系统追责；英国呼吁加强前沿模型监督。
summary.en: Microsoft's Brad Smith called for mandatory AI rules, kill switches and liability for rogue systems; the UK urged stronger frontier-model oversight.

title.zh: Meta推出面向智能体的Muse Wonder模型
title.en: Meta launches Muse Wonder models for agentic work

summary.zh: Meta发布Muse Wonder系列模型，主打智能体、编程、记忆和专业任务。
summary.en: Meta launched Muse Wonder models aimed at agentic work, coding, memory and professional tasks.

title.zh: 朝鲜向东部海域发射多枚弹道导弹
title.en: North Korea fires multiple ballistic missiles

summary.zh: 韩方称朝鲜向东部海域发射多枚弹道导弹，飞行距离超过900公里。
summary.en: Seoul said North Korea fired multiple ballistic missiles toward the East Sea, flying more than 900 km.

title.zh: 特朗普宣布俄乌立即停火打击能源设施
title.en: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine energy infrastructure ceasefire

summary.zh: 特朗普宣布俄乌立即停止打击能源基础设施，但莫斯科和基辅尚未独立证实。
summary.en: Trump announced an immediate Russia-Ukraine ceasefire on energy infrastructure, not yet independently confirmed by Moscow or Kyiv.

summary.zh: 利雅得哈立德国王国际机场再次遭弹体袭击，造成一名巴基斯坦籍居民死亡、11人受伤。
summary.en: Another projectile attack on Riyadh's King Khalid airport killed a Pakistani resident and injured 11.

title.zh: 油价维持100美元上方 美股涨跌不一
title.en: Stocks mixed as oil stays above $100

summary.en: On Oct. 12 the Dow rose 0.38% to 51,850.55, the Nasdaq fell 0.44% and the S&P 500 dipped slightly.

title.zh: 前三季度新能源汽车产销均增约11%
title.en: NEV output and sales up about 11% in three quarters

summary.zh: 《新闻联播》报道，前三季度我国新能源汽车产销同比均增长约11%。
summary.en: CCTV reported China's new-energy vehicle output and sales both rose about 11% in the first three quarters.

title.zh: 中国与巴布亚新几内亚建交50周年 两国领导人互致贺电
title.en: China and Papua New Guinea mark 50 years of ties

summary.zh: 习近平、李强分别同巴布亚新几内亚领导人互致贺电，庆祝建交50周年；李强会见越南国会主席。
summary.en: Xi Jinping and Li Qiang exchanged messages with Papua New Guinea's leaders on 50 years of ties; Li met Vietnam's National Assembly chairman.

title.zh: 郑钦文夺得中国网球公开赛女单冠军
title.en: Zheng Qinwen wins China Open women's title

summary.zh: 郑钦文在中网女单决赛中夺冠。
summary.en: Zheng Qinwen won the women's singles title at the China Open.
